title: Lammy urges Burnham take UK back into the EU
description: The former deputy PM's intervention comes after Burnham reopened a debate over the UK's long-term future.

title: What's gone wrong at Britain's worst bathing site?
description: The BBC looks at why in a dry summer with few sewage spills, one bathing site failed so many water quality tests.

title: Burnham promises to 'move quickly' on Neets report
description: The prime minister tells the BBC he wants to get "stuck in" after the Milburn report proposes wide-ranging changes to help unemployed young people.

title: Chris Mason: Milburn may have gifted Labour MPs a moral argument for welfare reform
description: There is hope his Neets report has created a case on benefits which MPs can back, writes political editor Chris Mason.

title: Harry Styles, Cher, Sam Fender and Billie Eilish to headline Glastonbury 2027
description: The festival will also host Cher in the Sunday "legends" slot, the unofficial fourth headline set.

title: Home secretary plans to tackle 'perception of two-tier policing'
description: Shabana Mahmood will announce stronger guidance on police impartiality.

title: AI used to find security flaw in Java, world's third-largest programming language
description: The same tech start-up that discovered a PHP flaw used AI to uncover a critical software bug in one of the world's most popular computer language programs.

title: Jeff Bezos says he was 'heavily involved' in casting Robert Pattinson as new Bond
description: The Amazon CEO said he was originally "biased against" Pattinson "because he's already so famous".

title: Watch: Millions of red crabs start annual migration on Christmas Island
description: The crabs were seen migrating from forests to the sea to breed on the coast of the Australian territory.
